structured_output.summary: The draft follows UI_RULES §12 and B14's scope. It flags the one done_when item that can't be met: at the current S6 layout, five cards at the 96px minimum need 512px but the row is about 491px wide, so they must scroll. Its acceptance criteria are observable in Chromium through stages, roles and the Web Animations API, and fail on main. No open PR overlaps it, nothing is retired, and the play-test steps are clear. The minor points go to the builder.

findings.claim: done_when says 4 and 5 cards fit unscrolled at 844×390. With the current S6 CSS (title panel 1/3 width, select padding s5 left and safe-right 48, 8px gap), the row is about 491px wide. Five cards need 5×96 + 4×8 = 512px. §12 (the owner's rule) says to scroll below 96px, so five cards will scroll. The draft rightly declines to change padding, gap or panel width (that would invent a design), and it has no test for five cards. That is correct, but it leaves a done_when item open.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: don't change S6 padding, gap or panel proportions to squeeze five cards in. Follow §12 (five cards scroll), say so plainly in the PR, and leave the decision to the owner (see designRequest and the backlog change request).

findings.claim: §12 says that at the minimum width names wrap to two lines and are never clipped. AC1 checks 96px widths, snapping and peeking in the eight-card stage, but not that every name is unclipped. At 96px the plate's inner width is about 74px (3px borders, 8px padding), so a long word in a 22px name could overflow, and the card's overflow:hidden would hide it.
findings.suggestedFix: In the AC1 test, also assert that every card name in 'track-select--many-cards' has scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth and sits inside its card, like tests/ui/track-select-fit-phone.test.ts does. Let the name wrap (no nowrap or ellipsis). If one word still can't fit at 96px, don't shrink the type: add it to the design request.

findings.claim: UI_RULES doesn't say how the BEST line (white-space: nowrap) behaves at 96px. The draft rightly sends this to the owner but doesn't tell the builder what to do in the meantime.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: keep the existing BEST styling unchanged (no new size, wrap or truncation rule). If it overflows at 96px, record that in the design request, not in a new visual rule.

findings.claim: The harness lint flags getAnimations in AC6. That is a standard Web Animations DOM API, not a repo internal, so it is a fine public seam. The hover and press half of AC7 already holds on main (title.css gives [aria-disabled='true'] :hover/:active transform none). Only the shake on release is new, so AC7 fails on main only because of that part.
findings.suggestedFix: No spec change needed. Builder: make sure the AC7 test's shake assertion is what makes it fail on main, and keep the locked rest rule in place while the shake animation runs.

findings.claim: '3 swings' with keyframes 0, +4, −4, +4, 0 is a fair reading of §12 (right, left, right, then back to rest). The builder should still not add extra keyframes. Make sure Space's preventDefault doesn't also block the existing arrow-key radiogroup handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Use exactly the keyframes AC3 names, one animation with no fill that cancels any running shake. Handle Enter/Space only for locked cards. Unlocked cards and arrow keys behave as before.

structured_output.designRequest:
Track select (S6), many cards at 844×390, two open points from UI_RULES §12:
(1) Five cards. The current S6 layout (title panel 1/3 of the width, select padding space.s5 left and safe-right 48px, 8px card gap) leaves a card row of about 491px. Five cards at the 96px minimum need 512px, so with §12 as written five cards scroll. B14's done_when says five cards should fit unscrolled. Which do you want: keep scrolling at five, or change the layout (e.g. a 4px gap, a smaller left padding or a narrower title panel) so five fit?
(2) At 96px a card's plate leaves about 74px for text. How should the BEST line (currently one line, no wrap) behave if 'BEST m:ss.cc' doesn't fit: wrap 'BEST' above the time, use a smaller size, or something else? And if a single word of a track name can't fit at 22px even when wrapped, what then?
backlogChangeRequests: B14 done_when: '4 and 5 cards fit unscrolled at 844×390' can't be met together with UI_RULES §12's 96px minimum at the current S6 layout (5×96 + 4×8 = 512px > about 491px row). Change it to '4 cards fit unscrolled', or add the S6 layout change that lets five fit.
